ValidationRule.description: Proof of address id number field is mandatory if Nationality equals Bahrain
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Setup.Setting__c.Bypass_Validation_Rules__c), NOT(CONTAINS($User.Alias,'guest')), ISPICKVAL(Region_Flag__c, "Bahrain"), ISBLANK(Proof_of_Address_ID_Number__c), OR(
RecordTypeId='0121t000000IVAH', RecordTypeId='0121t000000IVAF', RecordTypeId='0121t000000IVAG' ),
RecordTypeId != $Label.Relative_Lead_Record_Type
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the customer's Proof of address ID number to proceed
